measure: EU net hard-coal imports by ultimate origin
roundingNote: 2024 Russian volume rounds to 0.0 million tonnes but Eurostat reports less than 250,000 tonnes; do not state literal zero
legalMilestone: EU Russian coal import ban effective August 2022
findings: Russian-origin EU hard-coal imports collapsed after the ban.
US and Australian volumes to the EU increased between 2021 and 2023, but this does not prove equivalent net profit.
Russia redirected some coal exports to China, India and other Asian markets; EU access loss is not equivalent to total Russian export loss.
